text: Hino sirkooɓe ɓen heɗitotooɓe ma an Nulaaɗo, tuma janngataa Al Qur'aana, kono ɓe nafitortaa ɗum ; tawde Men Waɗii ka ɓerɗe maɓɓe kippoodi fii wata ɓe faamu nde, sabu salaare e ɗuurnagol maɓɓe ngol. Men Waɗi kadi noppi maɓɓe ɗin faaɗuɗi gaay e nana-jaɓa. Kala no ɓe yi'iri Hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, ɓe gomɗinirtaa ɗum. Haa si ɓe arii ma hiɓe wennjidira e maaɗa meere maɓɓe dow goonga kan, ɓe wi'a : "Ko adduɗaa kon wonaali si wanaa eggaaɗum e defte adinooɓe".
